name: icicle-plate
effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ice moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ice.
short_effect: Held: Ice-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Ice.
